Our story

A few of our favourite moments. Keep scrolling and watch our photo-booth strip print.

The venue

El Far is a cliff-top hotel above Llafranc, with sea views, the Sant Sebastià lighthouse next door and a stone watchtower from the 15th century. It has just nine rooms.

The wedding week

Thursday is for the hen do and padel, Friday is welcome drinks, and Saturday is the wedding. Tap a card for the details.

Pool party hen do Thu 8 July

Alice's pool party hen do. All women welcome! Let us know if you would like to join, there is a tick box for it in the reply form below. Time and place to follow.

Padel with Seán Thu 8 July

While the hen do is on, the guys are being shipped off for a day of padel with Seán. Time and place to follow.

Welcome drinks Fri 9 July

Welcome drinks at Three Pins, on the next headland along from El Far. A coastal path links the two, about 4 km or an hour on foot. Time to follow.

The wedding Sat 10 July, 3 pm to 3 am

El Far Hotel, Llafranc, Girona, Spain. From 3 pm until 3 am.

The details

Where is the wedding?

At El Far Hotel in Llafranc, Girona, Spain, on Saturday 10th July 2027. The hotel sits on the clifftop above Llafranc, beside the Sant Sebastià lighthouse.

What time is the wedding?

The wedding runs from 3 pm until 3 am on Saturday 10th July 2027.

What is happening in the wedding week?

Thursday is Alice's pool party hen do (all women welcome) while the guys play padel with Seán. Friday is welcome drinks at Three Pins, and Saturday is the wedding. Times and places to follow.

How do I get there?

We recommend flying to Girona (about 30 minutes away) or Barcelona (about 75 minutes away).

Where should I stay?

Calonge is a great area for villas. If you are staying as a big group, try Airbnb or Vrbo. Other places we suggest are Palamós, Palafrugell, Llafranc and Tamariu.

Can you recommend a hotel?

Of course. Let us know and we will send you some ideas.

What should I wear?

Details to follow. We will update this page.
